SELECT equipmentcode,
       (performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0) AS equipment_efficiency_rating,
       safetyindex * ((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0)) * 0.8 AS ospi
FROM equipment
WHERE safetyindex * ((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0)) * 0.8 > 0.75

SELECT pwrbatteqref AS equipmentcode,
       energyefficiencypercent,
       powersource,
       energyefficiencypercent * CASE WHEN powersource IN ('Solar', 'Wind') THEN 1.5
                                      WHEN powersource = 'Hybrid' THEN 1.2
                                      WHEN powersource = 'Battery' THEN 1.0
                                      WHEN powersource = 'Diesel' THEN 0.7
                                      ELSE 0 END AS esi
FROM powerbattery

WITH s AS (
  SELECT e.equipmentcode, e.equipmenttype, ls.lifesupportstatus,
         ls.oxygensupplystatus, ls.medicalequipmentstatus, ls.safetysystemstatus,
         CASE om.operationalstatus
              WHEN 'Active'  THEN 10.0 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
              WHEN 'Standby' THEN  5.0 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
              ELSE 0 END AS ors,
         CASE t.insulationstatus
              WHEN 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10.0
              WHEN 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10.0
              WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10.0
              END AS tie
  FROM equipment e
  JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON ls.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
  JOIN operationmaintenance om ON om.opmainteqref = e.equipmentcode
  JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode
  WHERE e.equipmenttype = 'Safety'
)
SELECT equipmentcode,
       equipmenttype,
       lifesupportstatus,
       ROUND(0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie, 2) AS lssr,
       CASE WHEN 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability'
            WHEN 0.7 * ors + 0.3 * tie >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability'
            ELSE 'Low Reliability' END AS reliability_classification,
       json_object('oxygen_status', oxygensupplystatus,
                   'medical_status', medicalequipmentstatus,
                   'safety_system_status', safetysystemstatus) AS support_systems_status
FROM s
ORDER BY lssr DESC

WITH c AS (
  SELECT commregistry,
         antennastatus,
         json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.radio_strength_dbm') AS radio_strength_dbm,
         json_extract(signalmetrics, '$.latency_ms') AS latency_ms
  FROM communication
), d AS (
  SELECT commregistry, antennastatus, radio_strength_dbm, latency_ms,
         CASE antennastatus WHEN 'Error' THEN 0
                            WHEN 'Warning' THEN 5
                            WHEN 'Normal' THEN 10
                            ELSE 0 END * (1 - latency_ms / 1000.0) AS cri
  FROM c
)
SELECT commregistry,
       antennastatus,
       ROUND(radio_strength_dbm, 2) AS radio_strength_dbm,
       ROUND(latency_ms, 2) AS latency_ms,
       ROUND(cri, 2) AS cri,
       ROUND(cri * (1 + 0.2 * radio_strength_dbm / 100.0) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - latency_ms)), 2) AS bscsi
FROM d

SELECT e.equipmentcode,
       e.equipmenttype,
       ce.heaterstatus,
       t.insulationstatus,
       ls.emergencylightstatus,
       ROUND((100 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0
             * CASE WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
                    WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50  OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
                    ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS ssf,
       CASE WHEN (100 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0
                 * CASE WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
                        WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50  OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
                        ELSE 1.0 END > 0.7
             AND ce.heaterstatus <> 'Off'
             AND t.insulationstatus <> 'Poor'
             AND ls.emergencylightstatus IN ('On', 'Testing')
            THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready'
            ELSE 'Not Ready' END AS extreme_weather_readiness_status
FROM weatherandstructure ws
JOIN location l ON l.locationregistry = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN equipment e ON e.equipmentcode = l.loceqref
LEFT JOIN cabinenvironment ce ON ce.cabineqref = e.equipmentcode
LEFT JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON ls.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
LEFT JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode

WITH r AS (
  SELECT l.locationtype, l.stationname,
         json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.solar.output_w') AS solar_w,
         json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.wind.output_w')  AS wind_w,
         t.fuelcelloutputw AS fuelcell_w
  FROM thermalsolarwindandgrid t
  JOIN location l ON l.loceqref = t.thermaleqref
  WHERE json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.solar.output_w') IS NOT NULL
     OR json_extract(t.renewablemetrics, '$.wind.output_w')  IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT locationtype,
       stationname,
       COUNT(*) AS equipment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(solar_w + wind_w) * 100.0 / SUM(fuelcell_w + solar_w + wind_w), 2) AS rec,
       ROUND(SUM(solar_w + wind_w), 2) AS total_renewable_output_w,
       CASE WHEN SUM(solar_w + wind_w) * 100.0 / SUM(fuelcell_w + solar_w + wind_w) > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable'
            WHEN SUM(solar_w + wind_w) * 100.0 / SUM(fuelcell_w + solar_w + wind_w) > 50 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable'
            ELSE 'Low Sustainability' END AS sustainability_classification
FROM r
GROUP BY locationtype, stationname
ORDER BY rec DESC

WITH e AS (
  SELECT equipmenttype, equipmentcode, safetyindex,
         (performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2.0 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10.0) AS eer
  FROM equipment
)
SELECT equipmenttype,
       equipmentcode,
       ROUND(eer, 2) AS equipment_efficiency_rating,
       safetyindex,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY eer DESC) AS efficiency_rank,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY safetyindex DESC) AS safety_rank,
       ABS(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY eer DESC)
           - RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY safetyindex DESC)) AS rank_difference
FROM e
ORDER BY equipmenttype, eer DESC

SELECT c.chassisregistry,
       (1 - (c.brakepadwearpercent + c.trackwearpercent) / 200.0)
       * (c.vehiclespeedkmh / 50.0)
       * (ef.engineloadpercent / 100.0) AS vpc
FROM chassisandvehicle c
LEFT JOIN engineandfluids ef ON ef.engineregistry = c.chassisengref

WITH w AS (
  SELECT l.stationname, l.locationtype,
         ww.waterqualityindex AS wqi,
         ww.waterlevelpercent * (ww.waterqualityindex / 100.0)
           * (1 - ww.wastetanklevelpercent / 100.0) AS wrmi
  FROM waterandwaste ww
  JOIN location l ON l.loceqref = ww.watereqref
)
SELECT stationname,
       locationtype,
       ROUND(AVG(wqi), 2) AS avg_water_quality_index,
       ROUND(AVG(wrmi), 2) AS avg_wrmi,
       SUM(CASE WHEN wrmi < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conservation_required_count,
       CASE WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 91 THEN 'High-Quality'
            WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 71 THEN 'Good'
            WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 51 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN AVG(wqi) >= 26 THEN 'Poor'
            ELSE 'Unsafe' END AS water_quality_classification,
       CASE WHEN AVG(wrmi) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed'
            WHEN AVG(wrmi) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised'
            ELSE 'Sustainable Management' END AS water_management_status
FROM w
GROUP BY stationname, locationtype
ORDER BY avg_wrmi DESC, avg_water_quality_index DESC

SELECT opmaintregistry,
       operationhours,
       maintenancecyclehours,
       operationalstatus,
       CASE operationalstatus
            WHEN 'Active'  THEN 10.0 * (1 - operationhours / maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN 'Standby' THEN  5.0 * (1 - operationhours / maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0 END AS ors
FROM operationmaintenance
